newsitem.title: USA: Rhone Rorer launches inhaler in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Rhone Rorer launches inhaler in Brazil.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc said on Wednesday its Brazilian affiliate launched the company's bronchial steriod inhaler called Azmacort, or triamcinolone acetonide, in Brazil.
The inhaler, launched by affiliate Rhodia Farma Ltda, is also already available in Canada, Puerto Rico, South Korea, Pakistan and the United States, it said.

"RPR is committed to globalizing its respiratory/allergy business," Jean-Jacques Bienaime, senior vice president of corporate marketing and business development said. "This launch represents a major step in that direction."
Rhone-Poulenc Rorer is 68 percent owned by Rhone-Poulenc SA.
Azmacort is indicated for maintenance treatment of asthma as prophylactic therapy as well as for asthma patients who require systemic corticosteroid administration, it said.
It is not indicated for relief of acute bronchospasm, the company said.
